name: kfl-plattform
description: KFL Plattform 2.0 – internes Dashboard, Partner-Dashboard und Formular-Dienst auf Cloudflare Workers

scripts.test: node build.mjs && cp dist/worker.test.mjs test/wk.mjs && cd test && node --no-warnings e2e.mjs && node --no-warnings import.mjs && node --no-warnings mail.mjs && node --no-warnings storno.mjs && node --no-warnings mahnung.mjs && node --no-warnings notizen.mjs
scripts.serve: node build.mjs && cp dist/worker.test.mjs test/wk.mjs && node --no-warnings test/serve.mjs
